scope: Actual packaged Nuxt application. Example service configuration is isolated; no production DUMB installation or provider account is contacted.
dataset: Public example API/WebSocket responses; system CPU/memory and task-owned process counters are sampled from the capture container.

sonarr.version_verification: Observed from the isolated application API.
sonarr.image_verification: Pinned image attested by the demo-service launcher and capture plan.

measurements.source: Linux cgroup v2 numeric CPU and memory counters
measurements.scope: Sampled capture container counters; example service identities and other API data remain simulated.
